subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the orange tabby kitten in <Picture 1>, about four months old, a real kitten in every body part. Keep its round face and slightly large head; short ginger fur with darker orange stripes forming an M-shaped mark on the forehead and faint stripes on the cheeks; white fur on the muzzle, chin and chest that blends softly into the orange; a small pink nose; large round eyes with big dark pupils and a thin amber rim; big ears with pale pink insides and fine white ear hairs; long white whiskers; slightly fluffy, uneven fur on the cheeks. These features stay clearly visible in every shot.
<Subject 2> is the black-and-white kitten in <Picture 2>, the same age and size as <Subject 1>, a real kitten in every body part. Keep its black fur on the top of the head, the ears, the back and the tail; a white blaze running from the forehead down to the nose; a white muzzle, white chest and four white paws; yellow-green eyes; a pink nose.
Both kittens move and react only like real cats: they walk on four legs, sit on their haunches, carry objects in their mouths, and pat, scoop or push things with one front paw at a time, or clutch and hug an object between both front paws the way a cat hugs a toy. Their feelings show through ear positions, whisker positions, pupil size, tail movement and slow blinks. They make only real cat sounds: purring, sniffing, a soft chirp, a tiny yawn squeak, a short hiss.
The whole video is what the kitten's own selfie camera sees: the camera is the viewer's eye, so every frame shows only the kittens, their objects and the bedroom, seen from the camera's position on the bed.
<Picture 1> and <Picture 2> provide only each kitten's identity: face, fur colors, markings and body shape. The lighting, exposure, contrast and background in every shot come from the shot description: a dim bedroom at night lit by one warm bedside lamp at frame left, with deep warm shadows and rich, saturated fur colors from the first frame to the last frame of every shot.
<Audio 1> is the sound reference for the purring of <Subject 1>: a steady, low, rumbling purr recorded very close to the microphone.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] Photorealistic vertical close-up video, ASMR mood, warm soft light from a bedside lamp at frame left, the rest of the bedroom in gentle evening shadow. The whole video is exactly what the kitten's own selfie camera sees: the camera is the viewer's eye, and the frame shows only the kitten and the bedroom. The video opens with an extreme close-up: one pink toe pad and soft orange fur press flat against the lens and fill the whole frame, blurred and glowing with lamp light. <Subject 1>, the orange tabby kitten with the M-shaped stripe mark on its forehead, white muzzle and small pink nose, lifts its paw away from the lens. For the first four seconds the view shakes strongly as the kitten handles the camera: it tilts up to the pale ceiling, swings down across the beige knitted blanket, and jolts twice as the kitten nudges it with the top of its head. Then the view comes to rest, steady and upright, at the kitten's eye level, and from this moment the camera is completely still. Now the view is a steady medium close-up: <Subject 1> sits on its haunches on the beige knitted blanket at the center of the frame, facing the lens; behind it, a light wooden wardrobe and a window with a sheer white curtain stay still in the dim background. Its ears point forward, its pupils are wide and round, and both eyes are fixed on the lens. It stretches its neck forward, whiskers pushing ahead, and its face begins to move closer to the lens as the shot ends. Only the kitten is in the frame.

overall_soundscape:
Close-miked ASMR audio in a nearly silent bedroom; every sound is soft, crisp and very close to the microphone, and only cat sounds and object sounds are heard. Muffled bumps and soft fabric shuffles while the view shakes. Two soft, squeaky presses of a paw pad on the glass. Three quick tiny sniffs, then the first faint start of a steady, low, rumbling purr with the texture of <Audio 1>.

nodes.title: 运行报告（每段用了哪些参考、时长）
使用说明
widgets_values:
云平台版用法 v7.5b（v7.5 云平台版 + 模型全部换成官方文件，部署脚本可自动下载；由本地 v7.5 删掉旁路的加速节点而来；v7.5 本地版：v7.4 + 加速换成 comfy kitchen 注意力 + KJ Sage + turbo 8 步 LoRA；v7.3 + Spark 稀疏注意力替换 Sage；v7.2 + 字幕支持内心OS/旁白/其他角色多轨，样式表可调颜色和位置）

【公共参数】（9 段共用）
  图片1＝场景首帧 H3_汉服女子_首帧.png（第1段开场照它）
  图片2～5＝四视图：面部特写、正面、侧面、背面（只用来固定长相和服装）
  音频1＝test_48k.wav（嗓音。参考音频一律先转成 48kHz 再用，24kHz 会被导演台抬高音调）
  公共提示词＝subject_definitions 整节（人物定义 + 声音绑定）。改人物外观或嗓音只改这里。

【素材组】每段一组，提示词从 summary: 开始写（summary / retention_analysis / detailed_description / overall_soundscape / non_diegetic_music），不要再写 subject_definitions，否则会重复。导演台会自动把“公共提示词 + 空一行 + 本组提示词”送给模型。某段要额外参考时传到那组里，编号从图片6、音频2开始。

【导出方式＝分段导出】每段存盘就释放内存。右边「H3 导演台分段拼接」自动拼成完整版，存到 output/H3导演台/<项目名>/v1、v2…：完整版.mp4（内嵌工作流）、工作流.png、完整版.srt、完整版_字幕.mp4、说明.txt。
说明.txt 会提醒两种“缓存是旧的”：提示词改过没重跑、参考图/参考音频换过没重跑。看到提醒就把那几段勾上重跑。

【只重跑某几段】导演台“选择运行”勾段号。开头会自动接上一段；结尾和下一段的接缝可能跳，需要时把后面的段一起重跑。

【采样】turbo 8 步加速：8 步 / euler / beta / shift 12·3 / cfg 1；上下文帧数 5。关加速：选中「turbo 8步」按 Ctrl+B 旁路，步数 25、res_multistep、simple。

【缓存】output/minimax_seg_cache 是导演台分段缓存，拼接和“选择运行”都靠它；定稿后可删。
【v7.3 多条字幕】（需要 H3-BatchShots v5.6）
  蓝字台词照旧写 <d>[Chinese] …</d>，会读出来、自动出字幕。
  只显示不读的字写 <os>…</os>，送模型前会自动删掉，模型看不到：
    <os>*不适合你。</os>          → 「内心」样式（默认黄字，在台词上面一行）
    <os:顾客>：我就喜欢这个</os>   → 「顾客」样式（名字可自取，样式表里加同名一行）
    <os t=0-1.5>*客人来了</os>    → 指定本段第 0～1.5 秒显示（没人说话的空档用这个）
  不写 t=：跟着后面最近一句 <d> 台词出现，显示到下一个 <os> 之前那句台词说完。
  只改 <os> 的字不用重跑视频，直接再点一次拼接就行。
  右边拼接节点的「subtitle_styles」是样式表：一行一种，改 颜色 / 描边 / 字号 / 位置(底部/顶部/中间) / 边距(画面高度%) / 水平(左/中/右)，
  或写 坐标=50,80 直接定位。不同样式边距错开，就不会挤在同一行。
  输出多了：完整版_全部字幕.ass（全部字幕和样式）、完整版_内心.srt 等（每种一轨，方便剪映）。

【云平台版加速节点】
  模型链：模型 → 注意力后端(comfy kitchen) → Sage 注意力 KJ(auto) → turbo 8 步 LoRA → LoRA Manager → 导演台。
  和本地 v7.5 的区别：删掉了默认旁路的三个节点（DMAD 4 步 LoRA、Sage 省显存、Spark SM89），
  所以云上不用装 Spark 插件，也不用管显卡是 40 系还是 50 系。
  导演台 steps 是 8，和 turbo 8 步 LoRA 对应。
  LoRA 路径已改成 Linux 写法（minimax h3/boost/…），LoRA 放在 models/loras/minimax h3/boost/ 下。
  注意：本工作流默认是 r2v（参考主体生视频），turbo LoRA 用 ref2v 版。
  想恢复 DMAD 或 Spark：用本地 v7.5 原版工作流。

【v7.5b 模型】（全部来自 Hugging Face 官方仓库，部署脚本自动下载）
  扩散模型：minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot（r2v、rv2v 用）。
    用 t2v、i2v、fl2v 等模式时，在下拉里换成 minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot（部署时加 WITH_FL2VA=1 才会下载）。
  文本编码器：qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq（和原来的 nvfp4 文本编码器大小相同，是官方文件名）。
  视频 VAE：minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16；音频 VAE：minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32。
  加速 LoRA：minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_8step_v1.0_768p_comfyui_bf16（放在 loras/minimax h3/boost）。

  Spark 和 Sage 只能二选一：
    用 Spark：Sage 节点旁路（紫色），Spark 的 enabled = true。
